title: Smartphones with UWB: Evaluating the Accuracy and Reliability of UWB Ranging
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical accuracy and reliability of Ultra-Wide Band (UWB) ranging in smartphones for applications like passive keyless entry and smart home automation. While it discusses 'security implications' and 'secure entry systems,' these are related to the technical robustness against attacks and unauthorized access, not the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as core components of the study.
